record.population: Historical evidence on salt, the slave trade and conditions of slavery
record.design: Historical review of the slavery hypothesis
record.finding: The review finds there was no salt deficiency in the parts of Africa that supplied slaves, present-day West Africans do not have a high incidence of hypertension, deaths aboard slave ships were not shown to have been mainly salt-depleting, and the West Indies evidence was not relevant to the US.
record.note: The strongest historical rebuttal found; it does not address physiology.
